prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a new Deadly Jenga game concept board answering the correction: REALLY SUPER TALL AND GIGANTIC, ENCLOSED, LOTS OF WINDOWS. Input 1 is actual Unity game visual style reference; input 2 is previous SMALL and TOO OPEN proposal, to replace rather than imitate its dimensions/openness. Keep simple shiny red, green and purple solid block aesthetic on sand island in blue ocean, bright sky, modest Unity game materials. Primary subject ONE gigantic straight rectangular block skyscraper, approximately 140m tall, 40m wide, 30m deep, 28-32 human-scaled levels, absolutely towering over tiny 1.8m toy player at entrance. It should be a formidable CLOSED hollow building mass, NOT an open skeletal parking garage. Thick exterior load-bearing block walls form all four faces, wall material covers roughly two thirds of facade, many well-defined rectangular WINDOW OPENINGS punched into it, three or four windows across each wide face, two or three across narrow face per floor. Windows have substantial solid sills and lintels; no glass panels or window-frame decorations. Exterior is FLUSH with no protruding floor lips. Broad red horizontal blocks form lintels and sills, broad green rectangular wall piers between windows, purple occasional vertical bands and roof blocks. Coarse large chunky block seams, no small bricks. Window holes large enough to see rooms inside but windows are NOT entire floor-height open bays. Single coherent enclosed rectangular silhouette, flat simple roof, no taper, no spire, no separate towers. All supported by gravity contact, no magical suspended floors.
Composition: portrait-like tall tower occupies left 60 percent of a landscape board, full height from ground to roof visible, slight low-angle three-quarter view, tiny players reinforce enormous scale. Right upper section: medium close-up of ENCLOSED facade showing actual window geometry and block joins; right lower section: a cutaway of a FOUR-FLOOR SLICE ONLY, exposing wide purple internal switchback ramps and landings, central open shaft, broad floor slabs split into a few large pieces, spacious enclosed rooms and doorway openings between rooms. Yellow route arrows only in cutaway. Label cutaway 'Interior slice'. Text limited to title 'MEGABLOCK TOWER', subtitle 'Gigantic • enclosed • windowed', and three small arrow captions 'Flush windowed shell', 'Large structural blocks', 'Internal ramps + rooms'. No budget numbers, no fake FPS, no destruction depiction needed. No realistic city textures, no furnishings, no hundreds of decorative components, no open-air shelf tower. Faithful simple actual game style, readable block geometry more important than spectacular lighting. This is AI concept artwork, not a screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept. Actual-game-style concept rendering of ONE GIGANTIC enclosed rectangular tower built from large red green purple blocks on the sandy Deadly Jenga island. Reference 1 actual Unity graphics and palette; reference 2 proposed enclosed tower shape, but now make it MUCH taller and more imposing. Full tower visible in a PORTRAIT composition, ground-level camera looking steeply upward with strong but believable perspective, near tiny toy-player characters at base as scale. Roughly THIRTY distinct rows of rectangular window openings rising to a flat roof 140m overhead. Rectangular 40m by30m floor plate. Enclosed opaque chunky walls with many rectangular punched window holes, majority of facade solid, no open floor-height bays. Three to four window openings across each visible face, thick flat sills and lintels, broad green piers, coral-red wall beams, a few purple bands, coherent coarse block joints. Windows open into dark enclosed rooms, occasional purple internal ramp glimpsed through window. Slightly shiny simple plastic materials as in actual Unity screenshot, minimal visual embellishment. NO exterior protruding lips or balconies. No taper/spire/realistic windows/glass skyscraper metal. Broad solid base entrance. The entire tower should feel like a colossal physics block mountain you can enter and climb internally, NOT a small apartment building. Blue sky, blue ocean at horizon, sand island foreground, distant ground elements tiny. No UI, text, labels, diagrams, extra towers, magic, complex textures or cinematic explosions. Concept artwork only.
note: AI concepts; dimensions are design intentions, generated floor counts are approximate. No implemented map, measured object budget, stability or FPS verification.
